description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractSubscriptionEvent' used for representing subscription events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes fields for event type, subscription ID, and headers, along with methods for accessing these properties, serialization to JSON, and equality checks. The class is package-private and intended to be extended within the package for specific event types.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a base for subscription events. It maintains event type, subscription ID, and headers, providing methods for JSON serialization, equality, and string representation. It is immutable and package-private, intended for internal use in the library.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the event, which is always 0 for subscription events.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns the current instance without changing revision since subscription events do not support revisions.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns a dummy entity ID as subscription events are not related to a specific entity.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events do not have a timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events do not hold metadata.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as the manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event into a JSON object, including type and subscription ID, delegating payload appending to subclasses.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to add event-specific data to the JSON payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on type, subscription ID, and headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on type, subscription ID, and headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event including its type, subscription ID, and headers.
